method: All nine source JPG files were visually inspected with view_image. Scene-to-clip assignments are visual inferences checked against the existing paired overview, not original take-level annotations.

photo_inventory.observation: Resolution menu highlights 4K/16:9 and 25 frames/s. Top-right text resembles HB | STD; its meaning is not assigned here.
R8 display shows 24 mm, 1/60 s, Tv, SERVO AF and exposure compensation ±0. No readable aperture or ISO value.
R8 recording-size menu shows 3840×2160, 25.00 frames/s, standard IPB; 4K 25.00P option is selected.

R8 on a ground stand to the side of two participants; four widely spaced blue discs bound the activity area. Main participant wears grey hoodie, dark trousers with white side stripes, red shoes and dark cap.
Same general activity arrangement documented from another viewpoint. Four blue discs form a large quadrilateral; R8 stand is outside the activity area.
Four closely spaced blue discs arranged in a row; R8 on side stand; participant with cap and red shoes is at one end of the row.
Same row of four discs from another documentation viewpoint. A small device is visible near the cap brim/temple region; exact attachment and optical-centre position are not measurable.
Four closely spaced blue discs form a compact group around the cap-wearing participant, rather than the long row in scene 2. R8 remains on a side stand.
Compact disc group documented from the reverse side; cap-wearing participant is farther from the documentation camera and the light-shirt partner is closer.

exif_interpretation.limitation: These EXIF values describe the phone taking the documentation photos. They are not R8 or Nano lens parameters; phone timestamps are not used to synchronize the videos.

support.observed: R8 mounted on a ground stand beside the activity area

exo.limitation: A setup photo records settings at that instant; it does not prove unchanged zoom, exposure, crop, stabilization or focus for every take. Stand visibility does not itself prove zero camera motion during recording.

mount_observation.description: Small device visible near cap brim/temple; consistent with a head-mounted viewpoint

ego.limitation: No explicit photo/menu record of Nano shutter, ISO, lens/FOV mode, stabilization mode or per-frame orientation. Screen text HB | STD is transcribed without assigning a technical meaning.

scene_geometry.visual_layout: Four widely spaced discs in a quadrilateral
limits: The measurement note does not define the coordinate origin, disc numbering or camera optical-centre reference.
The 3.6 m distance is not explicitly identified as horizontal ground distance or slant range.
The meaning of edge length is not accompanied by an explicit square-corner correspondence. Do not create metric disc coordinates silently.

scene_geometry.visual_layout: Four closely spaced discs in a row
limits: The note describes the nearest right-bottom disc without a numbered image-coordinate correspondence.
The four discs are approximately collinear; they cannot alone determine a complete plane homography.
The distance measurement reference and uncertainty are not recorded.

scene_geometry.visual_layout: Four closely spaced discs form a compact group around the main participant
limits: The shared scene 2/3 note reports 0.38 m disc spacing but does not assign all corner coordinates or define whether every adjacent spacing is identical.
Do not promote the compact group to a calibrated 0.38 m square without explicit correspondence.
The distance measurement reference and uncertainty are not recorded.

clip_scene_inferences.evidence: Overview row 01: widely spaced discs and scene 1 camera/background arrangement; comparison with 场景1机位1.JPG and 场景1机位2.JPG.
Overview row 02: same large disc area and scene 1 background/camera framing.
Overview row 03: same large disc area and scene 1 background/camera framing, participants temporarily closer together.
Overview row 04: four close discs in a row, matching scene 2 photos; documentation photo sequence also precedes the Nano filename time.
Overview row 05: four-disc compact group around the cap-wearing participant, matching scene 3 photos; scene 2 row layout is absent.

missing_records: Exact lens model and active sensor/crop mode
Numbered ground control points and their complete world coordinates
Camera pitch/yaw/roll and exact optical-centre position
Precise head mount transform and per-frame head orientation
usable_now: Document acquisition formats and a 24 mm / 1/60 s setup observation
Use measured heights and distances as geometric plausibility checks
Explain three activity layouts and pair-scene inferences
Use video image features for empirical image-plane matching/registration with residuals
not_supported: Constructing a measured K, R, t from height, one distance and focal-length menu alone
Treating phone-photo EXIF as video-camera calibration
A single exact EXO-to-EGO homography that also aligns people and the ball at different depths
Treating these capture notes as completed EgoX depth, trajectory or geometry inputs
